title: Plugins
subtitle: Manage desktop plugins: install, enable/disable and uninstall (live effect)

install.title: Install Plugin
install.description: Install plugins from a local .a00pkg package or from GitHub.
install.githubPlaceholder: owner/repo or a GitHub Release / Archive URL
install.hint: Injected plugins run same-origin with the host and have full app access. Only install plugins from trusted sources.

list.title: Installed Plugins
list.description: Enable state and uninstall take effect immediately, no restart needed.

deleteModal.title: Uninstall Plugin
deleteModal.message: Uninstall plugin "{{name}}"? Its directory will be removed.
deleteModal.warning: This plugin contains injected modules (same-origin with the host) and will stop immediately after uninstall.
